title: What is E20 Petrol? Benefits, Impact & Bike Compatibility
seoTitle: What is E20 Petrol? Meaning, Benefits & Bike Compatibility
excerpt: Learn what E20 petrol is, how it works, its benefits, impact on motorcycles, fuel efficiency, and whether your bike is compatible with E20 fuel.
author: RideVerdict Team

content.text: India’s government is aggressively pushing to promote cleaner and sustainable fuels to reduce dependence on imported crude oil and cut carbon emissions. One of the biggest steps in this direction is the introduction of E20 petrol.
Many motorbike and scooter owners now ask:

items: Is E20 petrol safe for my bike?
Will it affect mileage or engine performance?
Are older motorcycles compatible with E20 fuel?

content.text: **Quick verdict:** E20 petrol is a 20% ethanol + 80% petrol blend that is now rolling out across India. It is safe for all modern, E20-compatible bikes and delivers cleaner emissions with only a small (3–7%) mileage drop. If your bike is older or not E20-approved, check with your dealer before switching.
In this guide, we will go through everything you need to know about E20 petrol, what it means, the benefits, how it affects motorcycles and which vehicles it works with.

E20 petrol is a blend of 20 per cent ethanol and 80 per cent petrol and is being promoted to reduce emissions and India’s dependence on imported crude oil.
